question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A man whose wife is dead
solution:
The correct answer is: **Widower**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Widower"** means a man whose wife has died and who has not remarried. (विधुर)

 
 
• **Example: **After his wife passed away, he became a widower and devoted his life to raising their children.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Widower**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ascetic **(संयासी): A person who practices severe self-discipline and abstention from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons.

 
 
• **Example:** The ascetic monk lived a life of simplicity and prayer.
 
 
 
• **Widow **(विधवा): A woman whose husband has died and who has not remarried.
 
 
• **Example: **She has been a widow for ten years and often talks about her late husband.
 
 
 
• **Bachelor** (कुंवारा): A man who is not and has never been married.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a confirmed bachelor who enjoys his independence.
